t: You're looking at Harris Lowe Academy Willesden, a specialist sports and arts school in Willesden, North West London, in the London Borough of Brent. Until 2023 it was known as Capital City Academy, and you may still see that name. The building was designed by Norman Foster, who is widely recognised as a pioneer of high-tech architecture and a defining figure in British modernism. He is known for structural steel-and-glass designs, so it's worth looking at how this school, rather than a grand landmark, carries the work of one of Britain's best-known architects.
